A professional portfolio showcasing dental work and content by Jaidyn Tam. Fully customizable—the client controls all content, media storage, and site updates through an intuitive admin interface, allowing them to easily manage their portfolio independently. 

I built this to learn what it takes to build custom websites for clients. Looking back, I realised that development is only part of the equation — coordinating timelines and translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders turned out to be just as challenging and valuable as writing the code itself. It taught me that being a good developer means being a thoughtful communicator and partner!
